briefdescription.para: Immutable append-only audit trail for model mutations.

detaileddescription.para: Provides append-only audit trail storage with delta encoding (RFC 7386), temporal snapshot indexing, and CRC32 integrity verification.

simplesect.para: Maturity: 🟡 ALPHA (Phase 2 delivery, production hardening in Phase 5)
This implementation is auto-generated from ROADMAP_FEDERATION.md Phase 2.

listitem.para: Immutability: Once written, entries cannot be modified or deleted
Append-Only: New entries only added to tail; no retroactive changes
Delta Encoding: RFC 7386 JSON Merge Patch for efficiency (5-10% overhead)
Snapshots: Periodic full-state snapshots for O(log N) reconstruction
CRC Chain: CRC32 hash chain per entry for bulk integrity verification

sect2.title: Storage Backend Pluggability
sect2.para:
Audit trail can be persisted to:
RocksDB (primary, local node)
S3 (backup, remote cloud)
File-based (local dev/testing)

sect2.title: Temporal Queries
sect2.para:
Supported query patterns:
Point-in-time: QueryAt(timestamp) → model state as of timestamp
Delta: GetDeltas(t1, t2) → changes between two timestamps
Range: GetEntriesInRange(t1, t2) → audit log entries in timespan
Search: FindByModelId(model_id) → all mutations of model
